name: Coconut (Shredded)
siboNotes: Coconut is naturally FODMAP-free and generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets. The high fiber content may cause digestive discomfort in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Choose unsweetened varieties to avoid added sugars
Toast lightly in a dry pan to enhance flavor
Store in airtight container to prevent rancidity
Check labels for added ingredients like sulfites
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of manganese and copper
Contains dietary fiber for digestive health
